SELECT 
    SUM(o.OrderLines.LineTotal * (1 - o.OrderLines.DiscountPct)) - SUM(o.OrderLines.LineTotal) AS GrossMargin,
    SUM(o.OrderLines.LineTotal) AS TotalSales,
    (SUM(o.OrderLines.LineTotal * (1 - o.OrderLines.DiscountPct)) - SUM(o.OrderLines.LineTotal)) / SUM(o.OrderLines.LineTotal) * 100 AS GrossMarginPercentage
FROM 
    sales.Orders o
JOIN 
    sales.OrderLines ol ON o.OrderId = ol.OrderId
WHERE 
    YEAR(o.OrderDate) = 2025

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(gross_margin) AS decimal(10, 2)) * 100.0 / SUM(total_revenue) AS GrossMarginPercentage
FROM (
    SELECT 
        SUM(o.LineTotal) - SUM(p.UnitCost * ol.Quantity) AS gross_margin,
        SUM(o.LineTotal) AS total_revenue
    FROM 
        sales.Orders AS o
        JOIN sales.OrderLines AS ol ON ol.OrderId = o.OrderId
        JOIN catalog.Products AS p ON p.ProductId = ol.ProductId
    WHERE 
        YEAR(o.OrderDate) = 2025
        AND o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
    GROUP BY 
        o.OrderId
) AS order_gMargins

SELECT 
    (SUM(ol.LineTotal) - SUM(p.UnitCost * ol.Quantity)) * 100.0 / SUM(ol.LineTotal) AS GrossMarginPercentage
FROM 
    sales.Orders AS o
JOIN 
    sales.OrderLines AS ol ON ol.OrderId = o.OrderId
JOIN 
    catalog.Products AS p ON p.ProductId = ol.ProductId
WHERE 
    o.OrderDate >= '2025-01-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2026-01-01'
    AND o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')

SELECT 
    100.0 * 
    (SUM(l.LineTotal) - SUM(l.Quantity * p.UnitCost)) / 
    NULLIF(SUM(l.LineTotal), 0) AS GrossMarginPct
FROM 
    sales.Orders AS o
JOIN 
    sales.OrderLines AS l ON l.OrderId = o.OrderId
JOIN 
    catalog.Products AS p ON p.ProductId = l.ProductId
WHERE 
    o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
    AND YEAR(o.OrderDate) = 2025

SELECT 100.0 * (SUM(sl.LineTotal) - SUM(sl.Quantity * p.UnitCost)) / NULLIF(SUM(sl.LineTotal), 0) AS GrossMarginPct 
FROM sales.Orders o 
JOIN sales.OrderLines sl ON sl.OrderId = o.OrderId 
JOIN catalog.Products p ON p.ProductId = sl.ProductId 
WHERE YEAR(o.OrderDate) = 2025 AND o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')

SELECT 
    w.Name AS WarehouseName,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN o.Status = 'Shipped' AND ol.OrderId IS NULL THEN 1 END) / COUNT(o.OrderId) AS ReturnRate
FROM 
    inventory.Warehouses w
LEFT JOIN 
    sales.Orders o ON w.WarehouseId = o.WarehouseId
LEFT JOIN 
    sales.OrderLines ol ON o.OrderId = ol.OrderId
GROUP BY 
    w.Name

SELECT w.Name AS WarehouseName, 
       CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN o.Status = 'Returned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS decimal(5,2)) * 100.0 / COUNT(o.OrderId) AS ReturnRate
FROM inventory.Warehouses AS w
JOIN sales.Orders AS o ON o.WarehouseId = w.WarehouseId
GROUP BY w.Name

SELECT w.Name AS WarehouseName, 
       CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN o.Status = 'Returned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS decimal(5,2)) * 100.0 / COUNT(o.OrderId) AS ReturnRate
FROM inventory.Warehouses AS w
JOIN sales.Orders AS o ON o.WarehouseId = w.WarehouseId
GROUP BY w.Name

SELECT w.Name AS Warehouse, 
       (COUNT(CASE WHEN o.Status = 'Returned' THEN o.OrderId END) * 100.0 / 
        COUNT(CASE WHEN o.Status IN ('Shipped', 'Delivered', 'Returned') THEN o.OrderId END)) AS ReturnRate
FROM inventory.Warehouses AS w
JOIN sales.Orders AS o ON o.WarehouseId = w.WarehouseId
GROUP BY w.Name
